sloka: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं च न श्रुतं प्रपितामह ।देवानां भयसम्मोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ।। ७.६९.२३ ॥
transliteration: nedṛśaṁ dṛṣṭapūrvaṁ ca na śrutaṁ prapitāmaha ।devānāṁ bhayasammoho lokānāṁ saṅkṣayaṁ prati ।। 7.69.23 ॥

translations.english: They declared to Brahma that such fear and bewilderment among the gods, concerning the destruction of the worlds, had never been seen or heard of before.
